name: Oat Stoneware Cup
alt: An oatmeal-glazed stoneware cup with a rounded handle
summary: A softly rounded 9 oz stoneware cup with a comfortable bridge handle and an oat glaze.
description: Sized for coffee, tea, or a small pour of cocoa. The cup has a smooth glazed interior and a lightly textured exterior. Choose one cup or a matching set of two. Dishwasher safe.

name: Flax Table Runner
alt: A folded natural-flax linen runner with a short fringe
summary: Washed flax linen with a soft fringe. Measures 16 × 70 inches.
description: Lay the runner lengthwise on a dining table or across a breakfast nook. The softly washed texture works with everyday stoneware and natural wood. Machine wash cold and line dry.

name: Moss Stoneware Pitcher
alt: A matte moss-green pitcher with a curved handle
summary: A matte green 34 oz pitcher with a steady handle and a tapered pouring lip.
description: Use it for water, iced tea, or a few stems from the garden. The glazed interior rinses clean after use. Hand washing is recommended.

name: Amber Cedar Candle
alt: An amber glass candle with pale wax and a single cotton wick
summary: A 6 oz soy wax candle with cedarwood, dry amber, and a soft citrus note.
description: Poured into a simple amber glass jar with a cotton wick. Trim the wick to ¼ inch before lighting and burn on a stable, heat-resistant surface.

name: Oak Catchall Tray
alt: An oval oak tray showing its shallow rim and natural grain
summary: An oval solid-oak tray with a shallow rim. Measures 9 × 5 inches.
description: A resting spot for keys in the entryway or rings by the bedside. A clear oil finish brings out the grain. Wipe clean with a lightly damp cloth.

name: Moss Waffle Hand Towel
alt: A folded moss-green waffle-weave cotton hand towel
summary: A quick-drying cotton waffle towel with a hanging loop. Measures 18 × 28 inches.
description: The open waffle weave adds texture without bulk. Hang it by the loop after use. Machine wash warm with like colors and tumble dry low.
